WF-03 Step Final: Merge feature branch via GitHub PR.

1. Ensure on feature/WF03-f3a-pdui08-fix-20260530 branch
2. Fetch and rebase on origin/main: git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main
3. Push: git push origin feature/WF03-f3a-pdui08-fix-20260530
4. Create PR: gh pr create --base main --title 'fix(pdui08): TC-PDUI08-03 empty-search fallback fix' --body 'Fixes TC-PDUI08-03 by removing stale name filter from useDefinitions. Ensures empty search correctly falls back to unfiltered list.'
5. Merge: gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
6. Verify branch deleted from GitHub
7. Pull to local main: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
acceptance_criteria: PR created and merged to main
Local main updated with merged commit
